title_en: True Crime Meets Cosmic Horror: MrBallen Presents - The Terror Within Graphic Novel Delivers More Spine-Chilling Tales
summary_en: Get ready for more tales of the strange, dark, and mysterious in our exclusive preview of MrBallen Presents: The Terror Within.
body_en:
YouTuber John B. Allen, better known as MrBallen, has spent years spinning up tales of the strange, dark, and mysterious on his popular YouTube and podcast feeds. It turns out that those stories work just as well in the comic book medium, hence why Penguin Random House is now releasing a third graphic novel collection called MrBallen Presents: The Terror Within.
With the new book hitting stores in October, IGN can exclusively debut a new preview of MrBallen Presents: The Terror Within. Check it out in the slideshow gallery below:
As with previous volumes, The Terror Within is co-written by Allen and Robert Venditti, with art by Andrea Mutti. The book features nine stories in total, four of which are unique to print. Here's the official summary for the book:
MrBallen Presents: The Terror Within will be released on October 6, 2026. You can preorder a copy on Amazon .
Previous volumes int the series include MrBallen Presents: Strange, Dark & Mysterious and MrBallen Presents: Where Nightmares Live .
Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .
